package.name: nougenai-brand
package.description: The public NouGenAI brand surface: green-led, gold-highlighted, shards purple as the named secondary system.

tweaks.summary: The bounded exploration space for the Fleet Boards surface: five dimensions Dave may flip while reviewing the boards, every one bound to the nougenai-brand package's own tokens, themes, or enumerated treatments. Exploring changes nothing; settling produces a candidate variant plan that only Dave's lock can apply.

variants.summary: Stage chips gain a 3px status keyline on their leading edge, coloured by the package's status tokens, so a chip's state reads at scan distance without relying on the chip's text or fill alone.
variants.lock_effect: Every stage chip on both boards carries the keyline treatment permanently; chip fills stay flat panel tokens, and colour is never the only signal (the stage label remains printed on the chip).

variants.summary: Boards-only density step: cluster gap and row padding tighten one step on the package's space scale so a full board (200+ PR rows) scans on one screen, while touch targets stay at the package minimum.
variants.lock_effect: Both boards render one density step tighter everywhere; the brand package's default density is unchanged for every other surface — this is a boards-local mutation, not a package change.

variants.summary: Explored via tweaks manifest 'boards-exploration': stale-treatment = quiet; density = --space-4.
variants.lock_effect: Locking makes the explored settings permanent on fleet-boards: stale-treatment = quiet; density = --space-4. Until then nothing has changed — exploration never applies.

variants.summary: Rows stale past 48h stop shouting red: they drop to the muted offline treatment with a small gold STALE tick, reserving the conflict red for genuinely blocked rows only.
variants.lock_effect: On both boards, red means blocked and nothing else; staleness becomes a quiet muted row with a gold tick and the age printed, so Dave's eye goes to real blockers first.

variants.summary: The urgent section header carries the package's gold accent-rule and a gold count numeral, making the urgent block the one gold-ruled region on the board; all other section headers stay green-led and unruled.
variants.lock_effect: Gold appears on the boards in exactly one structural place — the urgent header rule and its count — so gold itself becomes the urgency signal fleet-wide.

verify.note: The shell's webview render is advisory (OS webviews differ per platform). A variant is locked against the package and judged by the reference gate, so webview variance can never change what passes.
